messages:
sam: Kicking off kernel+quant rollout for v2.11.0-quant. Target window: 23:00-03:00 PT. Will do regional quiesce & burn-in in batches.

deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: 2% global -> canary pool (gpu-pool-canary) at 1712345678

nina: heads-up — earlier perf runs showed a p99 mem spike on long-context samplers on A100S. Need to watch p99 and oom counters during canary.

liam: noted. I'll add a short smoke that runs long-context sampling with synthetic KV cache fill.

marta: suggest we pre-quiesce edge-region (eu-west-1) to drain active sessions before kernel swap. Otherwise we'd hit incompatible ABI on live cached states.

ops: +1 on quiesce. Plan? drain for 3m, reject new sessions, then swap.

sam: plan: (1) set canary 2% on us-west1, (2) run 10x smoke w/ kv-heavy prompts, (3) if OK => expand to regional buckets (eu-west, ap-south) with quiesce drains, (4) monitor mem/latency/regressions 30m per stage.

nina: rollback criteria proposal:
- p99 latency > baseline + 30% for 10m
- OOMs > 1 per 1k requests
- regression in correctness evals (top prompt set) > 2% absolute
If any hit => immediate throttle to previous kernel variant and pin.

liam: implemented smoke script. snippet:
```
# run 100 long-ctx samples
python perf_smoke.py --model v2.11.0-quant --ctx 4096 --iters 100 --kv-fill
```

deploy-bot: Canary health: 98.9% succesful responses. p99 latency +8%.

nina: 8% is fine. But mem spike observed at iteration ~42. Memory delta ~+1.6GB vs baseline.

marta: that's the kv cache growth we've seen when quant kernels change allocation patterns. Might be benign if it plateaus.

ops: can we limit concurrency on canary to reduce pressure and get clearer signal? set concurrency=8

sam: set concurrency=8 for canary and re-run smokes. Also pin eu-west to prev kernel for now.

deploy-bot: eu-west pinned to runtime v2.10.3 at 1712345790

qa-bot: starting correctness evals against golden set (100 prompts) on canary infra.

qa-bot: results: 99/100 pass. single mismatch looks like whitespace tokenization.

nina: whitespace regressions often from subword tokenizer alignment. Add to checklist for model-onboarding, but not a blocker.

liam: mem spike plateaued after ~60 iters, delta down to +200MB. Looks stable.

marta: decision: advance to region expand with quiesce in eu-west/off for now we pinned. We'll expand to ap-south with quiesce.

sam: rollout to ap-south started with quiesce: 3m drain.

deploy-bot: ap-south rollout 10% at 1712345850. Monitoring.

ops: monitoring dashboards show p99 within +12%, OOMs 0. No errors.

sam: final call: if ap-south stable for 30m, we can hit 50% global and schedule release notes draft. If any regression, rollback and pin to v2.10.3.

marta: I'll draft release notes bullet: kernel ABI bump, quant kernel improvements, known kv-cache mem transient spike under high kv pressure; suggested mitigation: concurrency cap and prefer warmed caches.

liam: added checklist for post-release: telemetry tag 'v2.11.0-quant' for all metrics, and a nightly burn-in on a small fleet for 6h.

sam: thanks team. I'll monitor overnight. Ping me if any :boom: or perf regressions.

deploy-bot: Rollout progressed to 50% at 1712345899

ops: tagging alert playbook: if p99 > baseline+30% or OOMs appear, execute 'deploybot throttle --pin v2.10.3' and notify on-call.

nina: leaving a note: we should add automated KV-cache histogram to alerting for next sprint.

sam: added to product/infra backlog. Good night all :zzz:
